name: Liang
source:
Liang is the character played by the player. His family has been doing business for generations. He once thought about not inheriting his father's business and becoming a knight who traveled around the world.
In 1626, the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanggongchang_Explosion]Great Tianqi Explosion[/url] took away everything from him. After his family was destroyed and everyone died, he became a refugee and then a bandit, doing many evil things.
translation:
Liang is the character played by the player. His family has been doing business for generations. He once thought about not inheriting his father's business and becoming a knight who traveled around the world.
In 1626, the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanggongchang_Explosion]Great Tianqi Explosion[/url] took away everything from him. After his family was destroyed and everyone died, he became a refugee and then a bandit, doing many evil things.
